ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/cream) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels, with black pixels concentrated in the central region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized black pigmentation zone bifurcating from the peduncle toward the median notch. Numerous small, irregular dark-pixel clusters (mottling) distributed stochastically across the high-intensity white field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge boundary exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude (1-4 pixel) serrations; edge definition is sharp against the ocean background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following a non-linear trajectory that increases in slope magnitude toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distributed dark-on-white focal spots across the ventral surface; larger yellowish-brown circular anomalies observed on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent brownish-yellow pigmented regions localized near the distal tips and central ventral surface, suggesting diatom accumulation or superficial lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark, protruding macro-features (possible biological debris or growth) attached to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
